subject: Request: Out-of-band comp & sign-on approval — Elliot Summers (AstralPay)
messages:
From: Maya Langdon <m.langdon@astralpay.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate request — Elliot Summers (Director, Model Ops)

Hi team,

Quick intro — I'm Maya (Talent, AstralPay). We have a strong finalist for Director of Model Operations, Elliot Summers. Elliot currently leads inference infra at a payments scale startup and has a direct background in cost/perf engineering — a rare fit for what we need.

Comp ask: base $235,000, target OTE with bonus ~ $285k, and a $120k sign-on (to bridge realized equity at current employer). Our normal band for Dir, Model Ops is base $175–200k with smaller sign-ons. Elliot is evaluating multiple offers and has asked us to move quickly.

Attachments: candidate CV + current comp summary (sent separately).

Request: Can Redwood consider an out-of-band offer (band uplift + sign-on) to close? We would appreciate a yes/no by EOD Monday so we can coordinate. Happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk through background.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Langdon | Senior Talent Partner, AstralPay
m.langdon@astralpay.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, m.langdon@astralpay.com
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate request — Elliot Summers (Director, Model Ops)

Laura/Aditya —

Putting this on your radar and recommending an exception. Brief rationale:
- Direct experience shipping inference infra at scale (payments latency constraints).
- Strong telemetry + cost optimization track record that maps to Redwood's Platform priorities (we're often asked to reduce per-token costs without regressions).
- Hiring risk: AstralPay is pushing fast — losing him likely means a competitor hire and a long search.

Proposed exception package (what I'm asking you to approve):
- Base: $230,000 (band uplift ~15% above top of current Dir band)
- Sign-on: $110,000 (50% cash / 50% RSU vesting over 2 years)
- Annual target bonus 15%
- Standard equity refresh clause at 24 months (formal language to come)

I attached a short market comp snapshot we used for the sales org and a draft offer memo. If we approve, I will route to Legal for the final template and to Payroll/Comp for implementation.

Ask: Laura or Aditya — can I get an approval (or veto + rationale) by EOD Monday? If there's hesitation, please call me — I can present the candidate background in 10 min.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Talent & Strategic Hiring | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, m.langdon@astralpay.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate request — Elliot Summers (Director, Model Ops)

Karthik —

Quick read. I am provisionally supportive of an exception for base to get this over the line, with two conditions:
1) Sign-on structured to mitigate churn risk (50% cash upfront, remainder in RSUs with a 2-year cliff + 6-month clawback if they depart within 6 months).
2) We log this as a documented band exception in the comp system with a short business justification (customer impact / rare skill).

Aditya — you own comp policy review. If you can ACK the financial mechanism (i.e., we have budget levers and the CFO is okay with the temporary uplift), I'll sign off. Steph — flag if this looks like a risky precedence.

If everyone agrees, route it through Legal and Finance. I don't need a live meeting unless folks want to discuss.

Laura Bennett
Head of Recruiting Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate request — Elliot Summers (Director, Model Ops)

Thanks for the context. A few quick concerns before I greenlight the uplift:
- Precedence: How many band exceptions this quarter? We are already tracking 3 other director-level exceptions — I'd like to ensure we won't erode the band.
- Budget impact: Is this coming from the hiring reserve or do we reallocate from open IC roles?
- Equity refresh mechanics: Need clear language on the 24-month refresh and P&L implications (we should avoid open-ended refresh promises).

Could you attach the candidate's counteroffer and a short summary of competing bidders? Also the proposed offer memo text (we need clear vesting/clawback wording).

On the sign-on: I can accept 50% cash + 50% RSU as Laura suggested if the clawback and documentation are in place.

Steph
Senior Director, People Operations | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Subject: Final — approved exception + offer next steps

Folks —

Thanks for the quick turn. Summary of decisions and next steps:
- Approved: base $230k + $110k sign-on (50/50 cash+RSU) + 15% target bonus.
- Conditions: 50% of sign-on in cash at start; remaining in RSUs vesting over 24 months with 6-month clawback if voluntary exit. Offer will be logged as a documented band exception (HR comp ticket REQ-3892).
- Legal: please review the RSU clawback language; we'll use the "Temporary Sign-On Exception" addendum.
- Finance: route payment code for one-time sign-on cash and confirm budget source (hiring reserve).

Maya/Elliot — congrats. We'll share the formal offer memo by close of day Thursday. One immediate note to candidate: the RSU tranche is Redwood common stock (standard grant agreement).

Elliot — can you confirm the start target window (mid-July) and whether the counterparty conditions include any outstanding equity acceleration from your current employer? We want to ensure timing on cash bridge is correct.

Karthik
